name: Tutti Frutti Ice-Cream
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: the richest cream
ingredients.originalText: two quarts of the richest cream

ingredients.name: extract of vanilla
ingredients.originalText: a tablespoonful of extract of vanilla

ingredients.name: preserved fruits (peaches, apricots, gages, cherries, pineapples)
ingredients.originalText: one pound of preserved fruits (peaches, apricots, gages, cherries, pineapples)

instructions.text: Take two quarts of the richest cream and add to it one pound of pulverized sugar and four whole eggs
Place on the fire, stirring constantly, and just bring to boiling point
Remove immediately and continue to stir until nearly cold
Flavor with a tablespoonful of extract of vanilla
Place in freezer and, when half frozen, mix thoroughly into it one pound of preserved fruits (cut up into small pieces) in equal parts of peaches, apricots, gages, cherries, pineapples

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take two quarts of the richest cream and add to it one pound of pulverized sugar and four whole eggs
2. Mix well together
3. Place on the fire, stirring constantly, and just bring to boiling point
4. Remove immediately and continue to stir until nearly cold
5. Flavor with a tablespoonful of extract of vanilla
6. Place in freezer and, when half frozen, mix thoroughly into it one pound of preserved fruits (cut up into small pieces) in equal parts of peaches, apricots, gages, cherries, pineapples
